svg.title: SceneDepthZ: linear view depth (reversed-Z reconstruction)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. SceneDepthZ: linear view depth (reversed-Z reconstruction) graph 0001 | DepthPassParallel pass | InvDeviceZToWorldZTransform from View bytes | Unreal units (cm) log10(view depth): 394.56 cm (blue) .. 905.43 cm (red) no geometry Reconstruction uses ConvertFromDeviceZ (Common.ush:1373): z = d*Inv[0] + Inv[1] + 1/(d*Inv[2] - Inv[3]) with the exact transform decoded from the selected View payload. Selected transform = [0.0, 0.0, 0.10000000149011612, -9.9999998245167e-14]; NearPlane = [10.0]. Units are Unreal units (cm) because the engine view transform is in world units. The colour scale is log10(view depth) between the valid minimum and maximum; it is a display transform, not a claim of linear precision.
